scope: Learning coverage index into existing skills, not an additional role registry or execution route.

domains.title: Graphics, illustration and key visuals
domains.exercise_no_render: Draw three poster thumbnails for a fictional book-exchange meeting; justify one focal point in each.
assessment_criteria: The message has a clear hierarchy.
Variants change the composition principle, not only color.
Distinguishes a logo concept, checked digital material and a verified production master.
domains.support_boundary: A paper exercise does not establish render quality or print readiness.

domains.title: Typography, layout and color
domains.exercise_no_render: Arrange the exact Polish texts “Wspólne czytanie”, “Sobota 12:00”, “Wstęp wolny” on paper; describe the reading order.
assessment_criteria: All required text remains exact.
Size and spacing support the intended reading order.
domains.support_boundary: Plan review is not a contrast measurement or print-preparation certification.

domains.title: Story, scene and screenplay
domains.exercise_no_render: Write a six-line scene: one person wants to return a borrowed item, while the other wants them to stay; end with a change in the situation.
assessment_criteria: Characters act from different goals.
The final line changes the relationship or decision.
domains.support_boundary: Support covers writing craft and scene planning, not complete film-set organization.

domains.title: Intent, actor and AI character
domains.exercise_no_render: For the exact Polish line “Możesz zostać”, write two different character goals and a gesture, pause and action supporting each goal.
assessment_criteria: Intentions differ through action, not only adjectives.
Performance directions are observable.
domains.support_boundary: Learning covers intent, blocking and performance descriptions; it does not replace practical acting classes, clinical voice work or review of an unseen performance.

domains.title: Character, references and continuity
domains.exercise_no_render: For a hypothetical character with only a frontal view, separate visible, unknown and additional-view-dependent traits; assign a role to each reference.
assessment_criteria: An unseen profile remains unknown.
Style does not replace the identity source; missing carriers do not weaken strict identity.
domains.support_boundary: Character identity is not guaranteed, and unseen traits cannot be reliably reconstructed.

domains.title: Storyboard and sequence
domains.exercise_no_render: Plan three shots of putting away a wet umbrella: entry state, action, exit state and the connection to the next shot.
assessment_criteria: Every transition has a clear relationship.
Timing is labeled as proposed; the board is not presented as motion evidence.
domains.support_boundary: A long-sequence plan does not establish continuity of generated clips.

domains.title: Framing, camera and light
domains.exercise_no_render: Describe the same cup by a window in a wide shot and close-up; select one version to demonstrate its use and justify the light direction.
assessment_criteria: The frame serves a specific purpose.
Movement and lighting have a function; parameter declarations are not measurements.
domains.support_boundary: Describing optics does not guarantee physical model accuracy or parameter availability in the interface.

domains.title: Advertising, product film and presentation
domains.exercise_no_render: Plan a 15-second demonstration of a fictional box through opening, use and closing; state the role of each event.
assessment_criteria: Events form a causal relationship.
The demonstration adds no unspecified product properties.
domains.support_boundary: Webinar support covers structure, narrative and material planning; live-broadcast engineering and multicamera production are not complete package competencies.

domains.title: Music video and song-to-image relationships
domains.exercise_no_render: For a fictional song about separation, select one recurring gesture and explain its different meanings in the verse and ending without assigning BPM.
assessment_criteria: The motif follows the emotional progression.
Do not assume every beat requires a cut or that the song was actually heard.
domains.support_boundary: Without an accessible song, timing is a hypothesis rather than a measurement.

domains.title: Copy, narration and brand voice
domains.exercise_no_render: Write two short announcements for a fictional reading meeting, one factual and one warm, preserving the same three supplied facts.
assessment_criteria: Facts and required exact words remain unchanged.
Tone changes through language choices without invented biography or promises.
domains.support_boundary: Narrative dialogue remains with the screenplay owner; VO text is not evidence of a voice performance.

domains.title: Image, video and audio prompts
domains.exercise_no_render: Turn “make an atmospheric clip” into a goal, one action, sources, constraints and two review criteria. Explain the effect of each part.
assessment_criteria: The instruction describes verifiable decisions.
Syntax and capabilities of a named tool require current verification.
domains.support_boundary: A prompt does not invoke a tool or provide complete control over the model.

domains.title: Voice, music and sound design
domains.exercise_no_render: For a door-closing scene, plan voice, effects, ambience and silence; mark the emphasis in a short sentence on paper and explain its purpose.
assessment_criteria: Each sound supports action or meaning.
Estimated cues, actual listening and verified rights are distinguished.
domains.support_boundary: Support covers voice intent, pace, pauses, emphasis and music planning; it does not cover voice diagnosis, professional vocal training or license certification.

domains.title: Editing, captions and animation
domains.exercise_no_render: Connect three described shots on a paper timeline; mark one pause, caption and transition plan. Explain each role.
assessment_criteria: Timing and transitions are consistent.
Caption readability and protected segments have explicit criteria.
domains.support_boundary: VFX covers effect planning and its role in a transition, not a complete compositing, simulation or application course. Code execution requires an available environment.

domains.title: Campaign, social media and complete workflow
domains.exercise_no_render: For a fictional workshop, describe the roles of a poster, short film and text, their shared facts and separate acceptance criteria and revisions.
assessment_criteria: Each material has a distinct justified role.
Facts, revisions, plans and actual reviews remain separate.
Strategy, logo and identity guide use the same accepted decisions and revisions.
domains.support_boundary: Campaign performance is not guaranteed; publication, uploads, current platform specifications and rights require separate verification or authorization.
